title: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Ensuring Fair Representation of the Northern Territory) Bill 2020
short_title: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Ensuring Fair Representation of the Northern Territory) Bill 2020

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would guarantee the Northern Territory at least two seats in the House of Representatives.
It changes the Commonwealth Electoral Act 1918 to require that two members be chosen for the Territory at each general election, overriding any redistribution that would reduce that number.
The bill would start the day after it receives royal assent.
changes: Sets a minimum of two House of Representatives divisions for the Northern Territory.
Overrides the Electoral Commissioner's determination if it would reduce the Territory's seats below two.
Creates two new divisions for the Northern Territory when new electoral rolls are prepared.
summary.affected: Voters and residents of the Northern Territory, including Christmas Island and the Cocos Islands.
